title: Tokenization Module Overview
summary: This module handles the conversion of raw text and audio into numerical token representations for models, and vice-versa. It offers base classes for general tokenization and specific implementations like RoCBert.

nodes.label: Manage Text Tokenization Lifecycle
nodes.title: Base Text Tokenizer
nodes.description: Provides fundamental methods for text tokenization, including handling special tokens, padding, truncation, encoding text into IDs, and decoding IDs back to text. It serves as the common interface for all text-based tokenizers.

nodes.label: Tokenize Text for RoCBert
nodes.title: RoCBert Tokenizer
nodes.description: A concrete WordPiece-based tokenizer implementation for RoCBert models. It processes text, word shapes, and pronunciations, converting them into numerical IDs for model input, and supports batch processing.

nodes.label: Handle Audio Tokenization
nodes.title: Base Audio Tokenizer
nodes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for audio tokenizers. It specifies methods for encoding raw audio into discrete audio codebooks and decoding these codebooks back into raw audio.

nodes.label: Raw Text Input
nodes.title: Raw Text Data
nodes.description: Unprocessed textual data provided by users or applications, ready for tokenization into model-understandable formats.

nodes.label: Raw Audio Input
nodes.title: Raw Audio Data
nodes.description: Unprocessed audio data, typically in waveform format, that needs to be converted into discrete representations for audio models.

nodes.label: Token IDs & Metadata
nodes.title: Model Input Tokens
nodes.description: Numerical representations of text, including token IDs, attention masks, and token type IDs, formatted for direct input into transformer models.

nodes.label: Discrete Audio Codebooks
nodes.title: Intermediate Audio Codes
nodes.description: Quantized, discrete representations of audio signals, used as an intermediate format for audio models or for efficient storage and transmission.

nodes.label: Decoded Raw Audio
nodes.title: Output Audio Waveform
nodes.description: Reconstructed raw audio waveform, generated by decoding discrete audio codebooks back into a continuous audio signal.

groups.label: Interfaces
groups.title: Core Tokenizer Interfaces
groups.description: Defines the abstract base functionalities and common lifecycle management for both text and audio tokenizers, ensuring consistent behavior across different implementations.

groups.label: Implementations
groups.title: Specific Tokenizer Implementations
groups.description: Contains concrete tokenizer classes that implement the abstract interfaces, providing specialized tokenization logic for particular models or data types, such as the RoCBert tokenizer.

groups.label: Data Flow
groups.title: Tokenization Data Inputs and Outputs
groups.description: Represents the various forms of data that enter and exit the tokenization process, including raw inputs, intermediate representations, and final model-ready outputs.
